name: win-ai-use-statement
description: Writes an AI Use Statement that maps how you use AI in the work and where a person decides, what clients pay you for that AI does not do, how client data is handled, and one line for proposals and your site. Use for "run win-ai-use-statement", "do I tell clients I use AI", "a client asked if I use AI", "AI disclosure for my proposals", "how do I explain my AI use", "AI policy for clients", "should I hide that I use AI", part of the Claude Guide for Finding Clients Pack by 90n.
